purpose: Chronological player-opportunity accuracy research. No betting outcome, odds, price, ROI, probability calibration, threshold search, or production promotion.
advancementGate: At least 200 locked-holdout player-games; at least 2% MAE and RMSE improvement over the validation-selected simple baseline; absolute bias at most 1.5 opportunities; QB, RB, WR and TE all represented; chronological integrity and zero market inputs. A missing major position blocks the gate.
restrictions: Final box-score attempts, carries and targets are targets only.
A target game and all later games are excluded from its features.
Routes, game-day availability, injuries, teammate status and historical depth are unavailable in the frozen source and cannot be backfilled as if known pregame.
Duplicate receiving-yard and reception records for the same player-game targets are reconciled only when their opportunity counts and team denominators agree exactly.
No market data may enter any opportunity candidate.
The locked holdout is evaluated once under this declared protocol and is not used for candidate selection.
